description: This file defines a Contact class used in an Android application, including a static list of contacts, methods for accessing contact details, and constants related to contact IDs.

classes.name: Contact
classes.description: Represents a contact with a name, providing static contact list and methods to access contact details.

methods.name: Contact
methods.description: Constructor to instantiate a Contact object with a name.

methods.name: byId
methods.description: Finds a Contact by its ID from the static CONTACTS array.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the contact.

methods.name: getIcon
methods.description: Returns the icon resource ID for the contact.
